canon.note: Skill Waraxe (122002) Wind DMG #1 L10 = 200% of ATK over 3 hits. Ultimate Terrasplit (122003) first launches Boltsunder Blitz (122008) or Waraxe Skyward (122009) on the target for a total of #3 = 6 hits, then deals #1 = 160% of ATK at L10 (122003); Blitz adds +30% vs Weakness Broken targets (122008 #2), Skyward adds +30% vs non-Broken (122009 #2); both base 60% at L10. Notes: the Ultimate's accumulated damage minimum of 6 points starts from 0, is accumulated for every two attacks made by Feixiao's allies (Ultimate does not count), and its activation threshold is 6/12 points (special resource, not Energy). Talent Thunderhunt FUA (122004): #1 L10 = 110% of ATK, #5 = +60% DMG for #6 = 2 turns. Bonuses: after Ultimate, ATK +48% for 3 turns; Formshift: Ultimate damage counts as Follow-Up ATK DMG and follow-up CRIT DMG +36%. Energy limit 130 (standard, unused by the Ultimate).

fixtures.env: Feixiao E0 solo vs 3 Wind-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7 — Flying Aureus accrues from Feixiao's own attacks (+1 per 2, Ultimate excluded); enemy attacks never feed the pool

requirements.claim: Basic ATK Boltsunder (122001, Wind) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
Terrasplit (122003) is Feixiao's Ultimate; it runs on the special Follow-Up Attack points resource (activation at 6/12 points, not Energy) and the canon accrual sustains 2 casts in this fixture.
Waraxe (122002) is Feixiao's damaging Skill; the slower canon pool accrual lets the fixture cast it 4 times.
Feixiao's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; never a generic attack action.
Terrasplit first launches the mid-ult strike #3 = 6 times per Ultimate (122003); the fixture's 2 Ultimates land 12 strikes, all Waraxe Skyward (targets stay intact during casts).
No mid-ult strike hits a Broken target in this fixture (Boltsunder Blitz label never used).

Waraxe Skyward L10 = 60% base (#1) + 30% conditional (#2) = 0.9 per strike while the target is intact (122009); Boltsunder Blitz (122008) uses the symmetric broken-target ladder, so the value matches either state.
Terrasplit's closing hit #1 = 160% of ATK at L10 (122003).
Thunderhunt FUA (122004) #1 = 110% of ATK at L10.
Formshift (bonus) is a permanent state on Feixiao once unlocked.
Formshift: damage from this Ultimate is considered Follow-Up DMG and follow-up CRIT DMG increases by 36% (122003/122004 Notes).
Formshift: the Ultimate's DMG counts as Follow-Up ATK DMG (dual tag), so Terrasplit's hits carry the Follow-Up tag and receive FUA-only modifiers — Formshift's +36% CRIT DMG.
After using the Ultimate, Feixiao gains a buff for 3 turns (bonus ability).
The post-Ultimate buff is ATK +48% (bonus ability).
Thunderhunt FUA grants +60% DMG for #6 = 2 turns (122004).
The Thunderhunt DMG bonus is +60% (#5, L10).
The 4 Skill casts spend 4 Skill Points.

Flying Aureus (special Resource, not Energy) accrues from the wearer's attacks +1 per 2 and other canon sources; the engine gate on ultConsumption 'none' means enemy attacks never feed the pool. Zero ENERGY_GAIN events reach Feixiao in this fixture, so the 2 Ultimate casts are sustained entirely by canon accrual.
The canon pool spends 6 points per Ultimate; the fixture ends with 3/12 Flying Aureus.
The Ultimate action starts before Terrasplit damage resolves.
